title: 겹받침 2: 닭, 삶, 읊다 — 뒤 글자로 읽어요
objective: Read ㄺ as [ㄱ], ㄻ as [ㅁ] and ㄿ as [ㅂ] at the end of a syllable, and hear both letters before a vowel (닭이 [달기]).
summary: Read the double finals ㄺ, ㄻ and ㄿ by their second letter.

task.title: Read the double finals
task.line: Decide which letter you hear, then write or choose the sound in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: There is dirt on your hands. (흙이 [흘기])

letters.sound: Say the second letter only: [ㄱ]. 닭 → [닥] (But in a verb or adjective, ㄺ before ㄱ sounds as [ㄹ]: 맑게 → [말께], 맑고 → [말꼬].)
letters.as: Like k in 'back', with no puff of air

letters.sound: Say the second letter only: [ㅁ]. 삶 → [삼]
Sounds as [ㅂ] at the end. 읊다 → [읍따]
letters.as: Like p in 'stop', lips closed, no puff of air

letters.sound: Say ㄹ, then the second letter moves to the vowel. 닭이 → [달기]
letters.as: Like 'help us' sounding like 'hel-pus': the l stays, the p moves to the next vowel

exercises: Choose the right sound: ① 맑다 [막따 / 말따] ② 닮다 [담따 / 달따] ③ 읊고 [을꼬 / 읍꼬]
Which final sound do you hear? Write ㄱ, ㅁ or ㅂ: ① 붉다 ② 삶다 ③ 읊지
A vowel comes next. Write the sound in [ ]: ① 흙에 ② 굶어요 ③ 읊으면
Do you hear the ㄹ? Write Yes or No: ① 닭이 ② 늙다 ③ 젊어요
answers: ① ㄱ ② ㅁ ③ ㅂ
① Yes ② No ③ Yes
